title: Page 208
transc:
No 1 5 PM
Capt. Van Duzer Nashville  Wash Oct.  23.1864
R. S. Fowler Memphis
Growl Lucy Oct harsh pebble for lantern Empress
& lavender drum ---- I recd Sweden wedge
having great appearance of authenticity that there is
to be a Walnut raid into Wilson Aurora pekin
that it is to consist of penny promise
sulphur & perfume purple panama & is to
start from budget Argyle on the pension day
of Nov bologna Copy sent to both places


Capt R. C. Clowry St Louis  Wash'n Oct 24th 1864 12. M
Growl Francis Oct Harsh Pension for Moon zebra Lehigh expected
to leave Eddy about the ghost inst for Arno and
perhaps Aragon zodiac He considered Your Saints sufficient to drive
Prize out of Aragon and wished you to Vermont him
as closely as possible unity Mellon was holding Magruder in
check on the Archery while Montrose was collecting whiff on
the Bermuda to meet Price on his return unity Despatches
for Legend should be directed to month of Bermuda unity
Maroon and Moscow should be advised as far as possible
of Prices Tablets zebra Keep me informed of your Tanners
in order that I may Plate them to John Ireland
